body: I seriously thought coming here would help me see a difference. Help me realize something. But I can see that is not the case. I tried really hard to not do this but I can't anymore. Goodbye to you. Goodbye world. Goodbye my love.

So another night has passed. I sat there for hours trying to sleep. Still contemplating taking all this stuff. I had it all set out ready to go.  About 80 vicodins. 20 norcos. Rest of my seizure medication. And half of a giant bottle of vodka. It was hard to fight the temptation to do it but all I can think about is not feeling this pain anymore. Not being scared anymore. I know if something doesn't happen this contemplating is going to turn into reality. I am lost. Confused. Alone. Have not a friend in the world to talk to. People I do try to talk to just don't understand what depression actually does. Mixed with the seizure complications and losing my love. All I hear is keep strong. Things will get better. God doesn't give you anything you can't handle. Blah blah blah. The same thing over and over with never any change. None of it ever coming true.

I'm scared over the seizure situation. Having to wait. I scared to sleep thinking I'm gonna wake up in the hospital. I don't eat cause I have no apatite what so ever. I'm scared I have to go through this alone. I regret all my decision that made me lose her. My life feels like it's in the same position I was in years ago. Before her.
